mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate level is below 3.0%.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 3.0% during the observation period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates deteriorating consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days when both series fall below their 12-month moving averages.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST fall below 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment expansion regimes, a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.1 percentage points over one month signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month during low unemployment expansion regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 over three months indicates weakening manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 110 over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust residential demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days when housing starts exceed 1000 thousand units.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1000 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it indicates accelerating inflation that triggers central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment increase (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% signals strong labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in one month.
